snippet.textDisplay: I haven't trusted BofA since they bought our loan from the back. Our payment date was the 15th and we always paid on time for the 6 months we'd had the loan. After 2 months we get a letter dated the 2nd of the month saying our payment date was now the 1st of the month and since we were late, they were charging a $50 late fee. I called and the person who called whispered that BofA did this kind of thing all the time and we should refinance with someone else. We paid off the loan immediately without the $50 fee and got a letter demanding the fee. We ignored it and never heard anything else. We figured they were paying their lawyers more than $50/hr so it wasn't worth taking us on. But we have made sure we never have dealings with them again.
